# Multiplayer menu notes (transitions lane, 2026-10-12)

Files: `mpmenu.h`, `mpmenu_model.c` (state machine, no game code), `mpmenu.c` (game side), `mpmenu_test/` (`make -C mpmenu_test test`, ASan + UBSan).
Variant build and test: `build_mpm/build_mpm.sh` (src/build.sh's file list + mpmenu), `build_mpm/mpm_rig.py`, `build_mpm/mpm_test.py HOST GUEST`.

## What the player sees
- **Title**: "Multiplayer" (a clone of Credits, under Load campaign) opens a sub-menu: "Host a game", "Back". The stock buttons are hidden while our page shows.
- **Host settings page**: "Pause: Anyone can pause / All must vote / No pause", "Speed-up: Allowed / Off", "Gear: Shared storage, equip own units / Shared storage, anyone equips any unit / Own storage per player", then "Host from a save" (stock load list), "Host a new campaign" (stock new-campaign screen) and "Back".
  The settings are chosen before the session starts, because dsnet fixes the lobby flags in the WELCOME.
- **Lobby** (once the picked campaign is in): the session starts (Steam: `mp_steam_host("", &cfg)`; no Steam: `mp_game_host` over TCP), on direct TCP port 47777 as well (any free port if taken). The stock Esc menu opens with its buttons hidden. It shows a text line ("Multiplayer lobby / Players / Pause / Speed-up / Gear / Local: <LAN ip>:<port> / Internet: <public ip>:<port> as Steam sees it (ISteamUser::GetPublicIP, flat API; no web lookup), else \"your public address + router port opening\" / Over the internet the host may need to open this port on the router.") and "Steam invite", "Copy direct address", "Start" and "Leave multiplayer". It reopens if closed until Start or Leave.
- **Guest**: after an accepted Steam invite, the title shows "Joining <host>'s game..." (then "... loading") with "Cancel". Then the guest is in game.
- **Title, Join by address**: Multiplayer → "Join by address" → Connect. It parses ip:port (`ui_parse_address`, default port 47777), then calls `mp_game_join` (need_save: the host sends its save, also at step 0). A bad address shows "Not an address ..." on the page.
  **Text field: no stock TMP_InputField exists in the title scene** (the new-campaign screen is not instantiated until it opens). So the page reads the address from the clipboard ("Copy the host's address (ip:port), then press Connect"). It clones a real field whenever one exists (SubUI_CampaignSetting +0x30, or any TMP_InputField). Open: open the new-campaign screen once, hidden, to get its field; or load the prefab.
- **In game, Esc menu**: "Steam invite" (host only) and "Leave multiplayer" (everyone), clones of Report bug placed above Quit.

## Hooks (2) and calls
| RVA | Function | Why |
|---|---|---|
| 0xE6FF20 | SubUI_TitleMenuButton.OnPointerClick | title clone clicks (the ui lane gave the title screen to this file) |
| 0xF2DC30 | SubUI_SystemMenuButton.OnPressButton | Esc-menu clone clicks. Each clone gets `Init(null)` 0xF2DB60 for its own onClick listener, because runtime listeners are not cloned |

Calls:
- TitleMenuView.OnLoadCampaignPressed 0xE710B8 / OnNewGamePressed 0xE71020
- PopUpViewContainer.ActivateView 0xF62554 / IsActivated 0xF62D64 (mf+0x50 → +0x28 → +0xF0; popup 1 = SystemMenu, 5 = SaveLoadUI)
- SystemMenuView.OnReturnToGamePressed 0xF2ED1C
- Views are found with FindObjectOfType (no Init hooks).
- Fields: TitleMenuView buttons +0x30..+0x60, SubUI_TitleMenuButton._buttonName +0x130 and _onButtonClicked +0x140; SystemMenuView buttons +0x48..+0x78 and _version +0x80; SubUI_SystemMenuButton._buttonName +0x28.

## Hidden-pair proof (pair CD, batchmode, TCP stand-in, 2026-10-12): 15 of 15 checks pass
- `build_mpm/mpm_test_CD.json`, log `mpm_run4.log`.
- Coverage: title clone, sub-menu, settings toggles (read back from the button texts), load list opened, host session + lobby panel after the load, Invite/Start/Leave shown, guest "Joining..." then "... loading" on the title, guest in game, host lobby lists both players, Start through the real OnPressButton path closes the panel, host Esc menu has Invite + Leave, guest Esc menu has Leave only, guest Leave, host sees the guest leave.
- Clicks in the test: Esc buttons go through the real `OnPressButton`. Title buttons go through `mpmenu_title_click`, which is the function the click hook calls. A real pointer event was not sent.
- The save pick was done with the rig's `load_save`, which is the same LoadCampaignRequested a list click sends.

## Re-proof 2026-10-12 23:1x, pair GH, main-build sources: 20 of 20 checks pass
`build_mpm/mpm_test_GH_run6.json`, log `mpm_run6.log`. Adds: Join by address page, bad address message, guest join over TCP from the address (no step-0 workaround), host on port 47777, Direct line + router note, Copy → clipboard read back, "Steam invite" labels.
**Fixed after run 6:** test copies (DSRIG_BATCH / DSRIG_HIDEWIN / DSRIG_SPACE / DSMP_TEST) hook GUIUtility.get/set_systemCopyBuffer (0x518AEA0 / 0x518AFE0) to `<copy>/clipboard.txt`. Run 7 (GH, 21/21) checks with pbpaste that the owner's clipboard is unchanged. Runs 5-6 had overwritten it.

## Open / other lanes
- pause_mode and gear_mode now go to mp_config and dsnet (`dsnet_gear_mode()` on every peer). The step-0 joiner is fixed in mp (need_save).
- Steam hosting keeps port 47777 too (steamnet: `mp_steam_host` keeps cfg->port, retries on any free port if taken; server on 0.0.0.0). First host run: the macOS firewall may ask to allow incoming connections.
- No Steam in the rig: the Invite button and the real Steam invite path (`mp_steam_invite`, accepted invite → `mp_steam_state` JOINING) are not exercised. Test them with two Steam accounts.
- Quit to title while in multiplayer: the menu does not end the session itself (steamnet's `end_session` decides). It goes back to idle when `mp_steam_state` stops reporting a session.
- Not seen with eyes: layout and visibility in a real window. Batchmode read-back only proves active state and text.

## Registration (done in src/: rig_main.c, rig_cmd.c, build.sh)
- `rig_main.c`: `#include "mpmenu.h"`, and `mpmenu_install();` after `ui_install();`.
- `rig_cmd.c`: `mpmenu_frame();` after `ui_frame();`. In `rig_exec`: `if (!strncmp(cmd, "mpm_", 4)) { char *mm = mpmenu_exec(cmd, line); if (mm) return mm; }`.
- `build.sh`: add `mpmenu.c mpmenu_model.c`.

## Notes
- Join by address uses the clipboard (no stock text field on the title screen): accepted for now (lead 2026-10-12).
- Public IP via Steam is untested (no Steam in the rig); the rig shows the fallback text.
- Port: Steam and TCP hosting both use 47777 (fallback: any free port), read with mp_server_port; matches steamnet.

## lan_v7 items (2026-10-13), proven by build_mpm/v7_test.py on GH, 13/13 (v7_results.json, shots/)
- Text fields: address (Join page) and name (Host and Join pages), clones of the load list's save-name field (SaveLoadView +0xB8; the list is opened once for a moment if it does not exist yet). Placeholders "ip:port, e.g. ..." / "Your name". The address is prefilled from the clipboard if it holds an address.
- Name: typed name > remembered name > Steam persona > ui_default_player_name() (Mac full name). Goes into cfg.name (HELLO). Remembered in <DSRIG_DIR>/mp_menu.json with the last host settings.
- Per-world settings: <DSRIG_DIR>/mp_worlds.txt "<campaign guid> pause speedup gear" (guid = ClanDataContainer.CampaignGuid = the save header's). Loading a world uses its line; a new world uses the last used settings. Sidecar file, not inside the game's save JSON.
- Load list tag: SubUI_SaveFileButton.SetData (0xF70150) post-hook appends "[Multiplayer]" when the header's CampaignGuid is in mp_worlds.txt.
- Quit to title: 90 title frames with the session up -> mp_steam_leave, state idle, Multiplayer button back (fresh title instance re-cloned). Host/guest can host/join again without an app restart.
- Esc menu (in game): the seed lines move under the lowest visible button.
- Autosaves: stock capacity is 5 rotating slots (GetCurrentAutoSaveCapacity 0xFCB670: 1 in iron mode / when the general setting is off). The join-point save is a separate mp_sync.json that mp deletes afterwards; map-change autosaves are the stock ones. MP adds no autosave slots.
- No loading during a session (owner rule): Esc Load disabled + label "Leave multiplayer to load another world"; SystemMenuView.OnLoadCampaignPressed (0xF2EEA8) and OnEvent(QuickLoadRequested) (0xD6C800) do nothing while mp_game_session() exists; restored after Leave. v7_test 16/16.
- Join refusals: messages for enum dsnet_reject 1..6 (DUP_ID: "a player with your id is already in this game") once mpglue exports mp_game_last_reject() (looked up with dlsym); else "Could not connect to ...".

## UX review fixes (2026-10-13, research/ux_review_2026-10-13.md items 1, 9, 14, 16, 17, 18, 22, 30)
Proof: `build_ux/fix_menu.py` on pair AB, hidden windows 1512x982, results `build_ux/fix_results.json`, frames `research/ux_shots/fix_*.png`.
- #1 Join by address no longer freezes: `dsnet_connect_start` runs the lookup + TCP connect on a helper thread (8 s limit,
  `DSNET_CONNECT_TIMEOUT_MS`); `join_poll` checks it each frame. Page: "Connecting to <ip:port>..." + Cancel (Back cancels too).
  Errors: "No answer from X. Check the address, and ask the host to open port N on the router." / "Nobody is hosting at X..." /
  "Unknown address..." / "Cannot reach X...". Once connected the socket is adopted and `mp_game_join` uses it (no second connect).
- #9 Session ended by the host (or any reason other than our own Leave): `M.notice` -> stock CommonNoticeView, Show_Confirm
  (0xF65498), OK only, once the title is up: "<Host> left the game. The world is saved on <Host>'s computer. To play again,
  <Host> hosts it and invites you." The Multiplayer button stays plain. No box found within 120 frames: text goes to the button line.
- #14 Lobby: "Share your address, then press Start when everyone is in." and "Friends outside your home: open port N on your
  router, or use Steam invite" (replaces "Internet: needs router port ... open"; "Internet: <ip:port>" still shown when Steam
  knows it). The world waits in the lobby: dsnet hold reason DSNET_HOLD_LOBBY on at host start, off at Start (every pause mode).
  Guest: new state MPM_GUEST_LOBBY while that hold is on: the Esc-menu panel in lobby mode with "In <Host>'s lobby / The game
  starts when <Host> presses Start. / Players: ..." and Leave multiplayer.
- #16 Join / Host pages: text-only lines (title button clones with every Image under them disabled): MPB_LABEL_ADDR "Host
  address (ip:port)" above the address field, MPB_LABEL_NAME "Your name" above the name field, MPB_INFO for connecting /
  errors (red) / guest "Joining..." status. An edit of either field clears the old error (obs.edited).
- #17 Host settings: "Pause: anyone / by vote / off", "Speed-up: on / off", "Gear: shared, own units / shared, any unit / own storage".
- #18 While the menu picks a save to host, the stock load list reads "Host a world" and its Load button "Host"
  (SaveLoadView _saveLoadTitle +0x48, _loadButton +0xA0); the stock texts come back when it closes.
- #22 One refusal wording: `dsnet_reject_text()` (net/dsnet_client.c), used by mp_game.c reject_text and the join page.
- #30 `mpmenu_lobby_open()` exported for the ui lane (hide the player panel while it is 1).
Not done here: the magnifier icon on the cloned fields (review #16 extra), bold `<b>` lobby titles (#11, not this lane's item).

## Rules in the lobby (DSNET_RULES, 2026-10-13)
- Host page and lobby: Pause, Speed-up, Gear and "Units per player" (1/2/3/4/6) selectors. The lobby's cog opens them
  for the host (guest: read-only summary from dsnet). Each change sends DSNET_RULES (`rules_send`), also once at host start
  (mp_config has no unit field). Changes made in play (the panel's cog, ui lane) come back via `rules_sync` (host, every
  60 frames): M.set follows dsnet, mp_menu.json and the world's mp_worlds.txt line (now 5 fields: pause speedup gear units) are rewritten.
- Test commands: `mpm_rules {units}` (a rule change in play), `mpm_claim {guid}`; mpm_status has `rules`, `owned`, `refused`.
